entry.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
entry.summary: The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest.

entry.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
entry.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.

entry.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
entry.summary: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

entry.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
entry.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

entry.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
entry.summary: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

entry.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
entry.summary: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

entry.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
entry.summary: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown fourteenfold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

entry.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
entry.summary: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

entry.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
entry.summary: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

entry.title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
entry.summary: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

entry.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
entry.summary: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

entry.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
entry.summary: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

entry.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
entry.summary: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

entry.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
entry.summary: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

entry.title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant

entry.title: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
entry.summary: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.

entry.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
